episode_title: Ep 505 - You Don't Need More Information. You Need This.
question: What is the PACE accountability framework in Better Body Academy coaching?
transcript_excerpt: PACE is an acronym that breaks accountability into four specific components: P is for posting into the group, A is for attending coaching calls, C is for checking in with weekly and daily check-ins, and E is for engaging with your coaches. Every single long-term winner in the program does all four of these things, and clients typically stop doing these before their results start to slump.

episode_title: Ep 505 - You Don't Need More Information. You Need This.
question: Why is accountability more important than information for fitness results according to Better Body Academy?
transcript_excerpt: Information is free and accessible via ChatGPT, Google, or Claude, yet this availability has not solved obesity rates. The host has coached over 4,000 people and can predict with 99.95% certainty whether clients will maintain results in two to three years based on their accountability structure, not their knowledge. Coaching is approximately 10% information and 90% accountability because a human will follow up when you go quiet, whereas an app will not.

episode_title: Ep 505 - You Don't Need More Information. You Need This.
question: What is the gym membership versus training partner analogy for accountability?
transcript_excerpt: A gym membership gives you access to everything you need—equipment, spaces, weights, classes—yet most people pay for it and barely go. A training partner who texts you at six o'clock in the morning and waits in their car creates accountability through expectation. The only difference is that someone is expecting you, which is what accountability means and why people actually show up.

episode_title: Ep 505 - You Don't Need More Information. You Need This.

question: What percentage of coaching is information versus accountability according to Better Body Academy?
